title: blemees-workflow role directory
description: Schema for the shared `roles.json` file. Provides editor / IDE feedback; richer cross-reference checks (claim_role values resolve to declared roles, etc.) run in `workflow validate`.

roles.description: Map of role-id → role definition. Role ids are kebab-case strings used in `claim_role`, `triggering_role`, agent config `agent-role`, and `wip:<role>` labels.

responsibility.description: One-line statement of what this role owns.

processes.description: Processes this role participates in. Free prose.

wakes_on.description: Events / signals that trigger this role. Free prose.
